Have Compassion on Them Missions

Your information.
Your choice.

Share only the information you are comfortable providing when you contact the ministry.

Prayer request drafts

The prayer request page lets you draft a message in your browser. The site does not submit the draft to a ministry database or save it in browser storage. When you continue, your draft is included in a WhatsApp link. Review the message and choose whether to send it in WhatsApp.

Sending a message shares it, and the information associated with your WhatsApp account, through WhatsApp to the ministry. Avoid including private information about other people. Once sent, a message may remain in the recipient’s conversation.

External services

WhatsApp and Telegram links open those services. Their own terms and privacy practices apply, and joining a group may make account information visible to its administrators or members. You do not have to join a group to contact the ministry directly.

The hosting provider processes requests needed to deliver pages and may retain operational logs. We have not added a site analytics tracker. The blog uses external font and icon providers, which receive requests when their resources load.

Blog preferences

The writings archive uses your browser’s local storage for reading preferences and saved article bookmarks. These choices stay in that browser. You can remove them by clearing this site’s browser data.

Questions about information

Contact the ministry on WhatsApp with questions about a message you have sent or to request removal of information from ministry-held conversations. Handling and any retention obligations depend on the message and services involved.
